We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. Position Description Bridgenext is seeking an experienced GIS Developer to design, develop, test, maintain, and enhance geospatial applications and data-management solutions supporting timberland, agriculture, natural resources, and broader land-management operations. The role requires strong GIS development, spatial-data management, system-integration, automation, and modern web-development capabilities. The GIS Developer will build scalable solutions using the Esri ArcGIS platform, Python, SQL, Microsoft Azure services, and contemporary web technologies to support informed operational and investment decisions. The successful candidate will collaborate with GIS Analysts, Business Analysts, land managers, forestry and agriculture professionals, Product Owners, and technology teams to translate complex geospatial requirements into secure, reliable, and user-focused solutions. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain GIS web applications, geospatial services, and supporting data solutions. Build and support integrations between ArcGIS platforms and enterprise systems, including land-information management, forest operations, reporting, and environmental or safety platforms. Develop and maintain ArcGIS geoprocessing tools, Python/ArcPy automation, scheduled workflows, REST APIs, and reusable services for spatial processing and resource-management activities. Create, publish, administer, and optimize ArcGIS map services, feature services, geoprocessing services, image services, mobile data services, and offline map packages. Develop interactive mapping and responsive GIS applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, with appropriate authentication, authorization, and role-based access controls. Support backend and full-stack development for GIS applications using modern APIs, web technologies, and enterprise integration patterns. Manage and maintain enterprise geospatial datasets, parcel information, forest inventory, farmland and timberland boundaries, resource data, and related business attributes. Support spatial editing workflows for harvesting, regeneration, dispositions, casualty loss, exclusion areas, acreage tracking, leases, inspections, and field operations. Develop or support growth-and-yield modeling, forest-inventory analysis, spatial joins, overlays, and other geospatial analytics used in harvest planning and investment decisions. Ensure spatial-data integrity and consistency across ArcGIS, enterprise geodatabases, integrated applications, and downstream reporting platforms through validation, verification, and reconciliation controls. Write and optimize spatial SQL queries for Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL Managed Instance, including enterprise geodatabase administration, spatial indexing, reporting, migration, and domain management. Develop and support big-data geospatial workflows using Databricks, PySpark, GeoPandas, Databricks Mosaic, ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake, and Parquet where applicable. Develop solutions for mobile and offline field-data collection using ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, Collector, and custom field applications. Support Azure Active Directory group synchronization, Single Sign-On, least-privilege access, ArcGIS Portal group governance, and periodic access reviews. Participate in solution design, sprint planning, story refinement, estimation, testing, user acceptance, release activities, peer reviews, and continuous-improvement initiatives. Troubleshoot and resolve production issues involving spatial data, map and feature services, application integrations, performance, valuations, reporting, and field workflows. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployments using GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps or Harness, Artifactory, and related DevSecOps practices. Must Have Skills: Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 5+ years of professional experience in GIS application development and geospatial technologies. Strong hands-on experience with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Portal, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, and enterprise ArcGIS administration concepts. Proficiency in Python and ArcPy for geoprocessing, spatial automation, data migration, and administrative workflows. Strong SQL and database-development experience, including spatial data types, enterprise geodatabases/SDE, spatial indexing, and query optimization. Experience developing web applications using JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. Knowledge of ArcGIS REST APIs, RESTful service design, system integrations, and secure API consumption. Experience creating and supporting map, feature, geoprocessing, image, and mobile/offline GIS services. Experience with Databricks, PySpark, GeoPandas, Databricks Mosaic, Delta Lake, ADLS Gen2, Parquet, and large-scale spatial analytics. Experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud-based GIS or application environments. Working knowledge of Azure Active Directory, SSO, role-based access, and enterprise security controls. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, spatial-data validation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders and translate functional geospatial requirements into technical solutions. Preferred Skills: Experience in forestry, timberland, agriculture, natural resources, real assets, or land-management domains. Experience with timber harvest applications, forest inventory, growth-and-yield modeling, parcel management, farmland operations, or environmental and safety systems. Hands-on experience with ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, Collector, mobile field solutions, and offline GIS workflows. Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, enterprise data lakes, data governance, and spatially enabled reporting solutions. Knowledge of .NET/C#, Java, FastAPI, React Native, Flutter, or other technologies used to integrate GIS with enterprise and mobile applications. Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Harness, JFrog Artifactory, Jira, and Confluence. Familiarity with ArcMap/Citrix legacy environments and modernization or migration to ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Enterprise. Professional Skills: Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to explain technical GIS concepts to business and operational stakeholders. Collaborative team player who can work effectively with GIS Analysts, Business Analysts, land managers, field teams, and cross-functional technology squads. High standards of professionalism, ownership, documentation, code quality, and production support. Self-sufficient and organized, with the ability to prioritize concurrent development, support, and data-quality activities. Flexible and improvement-oriented, with sound judgment and a practical approach to solving complex spatial and integration problems. Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

full_description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 2 years of experience with software development in C++, Java, Python, or Go programming languages. Experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems. Preferred qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field. Experience in building and managing services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar cloud environments (e.g., using Kubernetes, Cloud Run). Experience with high-availability load balancing and networking technologies. Deep knowledge of cloud security concepts, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and Zero Trust architectures Deep understanding of agentic workflows including Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. About the job Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The team is securing the next generation of generative AI and agentic applications with a deny-by-default security perimeter for Artificial Intelligence (AI). It automatically enforces dynamic ingress and egress guardrails on every interaction between agents, models, tools and data across the enterprise. Building on Google Cloud's identity and policy stack (e.g., Identity and Access Management (IAM) Unified Access Policies, Principal Access Boundaries, Identity-Aware Proxy, Agent Gateway and Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Service Controls), we turn intent such as "this agent may read tickets but never delete records" into context-aware boundaries that are enforced at runtime.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Responsibilities Design, build, and deploy data-plane and control-plane components enforcing deny-by-default AI policies. Own features from design through launch, and help shape your roadmap. Build low-latency services that evaluate identity, context, and policy at Google Cloud scale. Author design docs and weigh performance, reliability, and maintenance trade-offs with senior engineers. Partner with Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Run, IAM, and Agent Platform to integrate your features. Help define API agreements and integration details, and flag cross-team blockers early. Find and fix component risks, from policy correctness to failure modes and abuse paths. Join on-call response, resolve production incidents, and ensure fixes land. Turn requirements into clear milestones, estimate reliably, and deliver on schedule. Steer features through launch, including dry-runs and safe enforcement. Write clean, tested, documented code. Conduct thorough code reviews, and mentor Level3 engineers and interns. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: AI Ops Engineer
skills: Python, Microservices, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD
full_description: The Ford Credit Global Data Insights and Analytics (FC - GDIA) department is looking for a motivated and talented AI – Ops Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI operations expertise to build, automate, and secure the platform that powers our advanced artificial intelligence solutions for the Ford Credit team. In this role, you will act as the backbone of our quantitative analytics and AI engineering teams. Your primary mission will be to design, automate, and operate the end-to-end cloud and AI infrastructure — including CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, observability, and platform guardrails — so that our Generative AI applications and modelers can run safely, scalably, and reliably in production. Cloud Platform Engineering: Architect and operate highly available, multi-service AI infrastructure on the cloud, managing the full lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, and security for AI workloads. AI-Ops / LLMOps Pipelines: Establish robust MLOps and LLMOps pipelines covering the end-to-end lifecycle of Generative AI tools — including model deployment, version control, prompt and artifact tracking, automated evaluation, and continuous monitoring for performance, drift, and hallucination mitigation. CI/CD Automation: Design and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for full-stack AI applications, ensuring seamless and secure continuous integration and delivery across front-end, back-end, and AI components. Infrastructure as Code: Manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Build, Kubernetes manifests) to deliver reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments. Containerization & Orchestration: Build and operate containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), managing scaling, rolling deployments, resource optimization, and service resilience for AI workloads. Observability & Reliability: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SRE practices to ensure platform reliability, availability, and performance of AI applications in production. Security & Governance: Embed security across the platform — identity and access management, secrets management, network policies, and data protection — ensuring all AI workloads meet Ford's strict data privacy, security, and compliance standards. Developer Enablement: Work closely with AI engineers, software engineers, and analytical modelers to provide self-service tooling, environments, and automated workflows that remove friction from development to production. Skills Knowledge Required Cloud Platform: Extensive hands-on experience with a leading cloud provider (e.g., Google Cloud Platform), including Cloud Run, Cloud Build, GKE, GCS, BigQuery, IAM, VPC networking, and Secret Manager. DevOps / SRE Practices: Strong proficiency in CI/CD tooling, GitOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native monitoring and logging. AI-Ops / LLMOps: Proficiency in tools and platforms for model deployment, prompt/model versioning, evaluation, tracing, and monitoring of LLM and GenAI outputs. Scripting & Automation: Hands-on experience with a programming/scripting language such as Python, or Bash for automating infrastructure and operational tasks, and for building tooling that serves collaborators. Software Engineering Fundamentals: Working knowledge of full-stack application architecture and modern deployment patterns for AI tools, with the ability to integrate front-end, back-end, and AI services reliably. Security & Compliance: Familiarity with cloud security best practices, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance standards in regulated environments. Analytics Workflow Understanding: Awareness of the typical workflows of data scientists and modelers (data wrangling, feature engineering, model validation) so you can build reliable platforms and pipelines that serve them. Qualifications Experience Education: Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline. DevOps/Cloud Engineering Experience: 3–5 years of overall experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with at least 1–2 years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying and operating AI, ML, and Generative AI applications in production.
